verdict.rationale: Adyen documents risk experiments that A/B test two risk profiles to see which performs better, and markets rule backtesting against historical data before go-live. Together these cover pre-deployment evaluation of rules, but not explicit model metrics or true shadow mode. missing for 10: explicit precision/recall (or equivalent model-performance) metrics on the merchant's own traffic, shadow-mode trials that score without affecting decisions, evaluation of new ML models (not just rules or profiles), in-depth docs on experiment metrics, independent corroboration.
